general.summary: Kallum Pickering, chief economist at Peel Hunt, says US markets are going to have a "pretty painful ride," and the Federal Reserve will need to scale back its rate-hike expectations. "Into next year, we'll start repositioning away from the US towards the companies that can use this stuff," he tells Bloomberg Television. Pickering adds a 50 bps rate hike from the Fed in December would be a "big mistake," and instead he expects one other increase early next year. Original filen
